text:
dina: Quick sync - product locked the v1 sunset date. We need a compact PR that: 1) updates SDK snippets (param rename model_id -> model), 2) adds embed-dim troubleshooting, 3) archives v1 examples under /legacy with a deprecation banner. Can owners volunteer?

omar: I'll take JS/TS snippets and the streaming example. Will include before/after and a small migration diff.

kelly: I'll cover Python and the embed-dim fallback pattern. Suggest code sample that retries with a compat model when dims mismatch.

docs-bot: Reminder: add label `docs/compat` and `preview/ready` to trigger staging preview. Editorial freeze 48h before the deprecation email.

odina (typo, corrected): sorry, meant dina.

dina: Also, important: the docs shim only maps parameter names. It does NOT reproject embeddings or change runtime semantics. Call that out prominently.

sdk-eng: Confirmed. We'll add a changelog note: "Breaking: model_id -> model. Shim available until 2026-05-20; maps keys only."

omar: Draft snippet for streaming change: 
// v1
client.stream({ model_id: 'chat-old', onData: (s) => console.log(s) })
// v2
client.stream({ model: 'chat-new', onEvent: ({ event, chunk }) => { if (event === 'data') console.log(chunk) } })

kelly: Python embed fallback: 
vec = embeddings.create(model='rwd-embed-v2', input=text)
if len(vec) != expected_dim:
    vec = embeddings.create(model='rwd-embed-compat', input=text)

docs-bot: QA checklist: 1) snippets updated, 2) preview build green, 3) smoke tests pass, 4) legacy pages show banner.

support: Please add the one-page migration summary link to canned responses. We'll include the embed-dim triage steps.

dina: Timeline: open PRs by EOD Wed, review Thu, merge Fri. Call out blockers now.

omar: Pushing JS PR now, tag `preview/ready`.

kelly: Python PR open. Adding smoke tests to the PR description.

docs-bot: Preview builds queued.

(brief pause)

docs-bot: Preview builds green for both PRs. Smoke tests: streaming snippet initially failed; omar pushed a fix, re-run OK.

dina: Great. I'll merge and then coordinate the deprecation notice with comms/support. Thanks team!
